items.title: UpdateBasket with a negative and a zero quantity is rejected and nothing is stored
covers: Expected: INVALID_ARGUMENT; Redis is unchanged
items.reason: Reproduction of the bug: `BasketItem.Validate` was never called, so invalid lines were persisted. Functional layer because status code and Redis state need the real service and Redis.

items.title: INVALID_ARGUMENT message reports every invalid line
covers: Implementation Notes: all invalid lines are reported in one INVALID_ARGUMENT message
items.reason: The story decision says all invalid lines are reported together; a regression stopping at the first error would hide the second. Separate from TC-01 because it checks the message text, not only the status.

items.title: A single line with quantity 0 is rejected
covers: Technical Notes: Quantity < 1 is invalid (boundary 0)
items.reason: Boundary just outside the minimum of 1; separate from the negative case so each side of the `Quantity < 1` check is proven alone.

items.title: A single line with quantity -1 is rejected
covers: Technical Notes: Quantity < 1 is invalid (negative)
items.reason: -1 is the negative neighbor of zero; proves a negative alone (without a zero line) is rejected.

items.title: A line with quantity 1 is accepted and stored
covers: Technical Notes: Quantity < 1 is invalid (boundary 1 is valid)
items.reason: Boundary just inside the limit; guards against an over-strict fix (for example rejecting `Quantity <= 1`) and proves valid input still saves.

items.title: A request with one valid and one invalid line leaves an existing basket unchanged
covers: Expected: Redis is unchanged
Implementation Notes: validation throws before UpdateBasketAsync
items.reason: Validation must be all-or-nothing; a partial save of the valid line would still change Redis. Uses bob's seeded basket to also prove prior data is untouched.

items.title: An update with no items is still accepted
covers: Implementation Notes: empty baskets stay valid
items.reason: The fix must not treat an empty item list as invalid; this existing behavior could regress if validation required at least one line.
